newsitem.title: USA: Glickman to fight to open Chile to US agriculture.
newsitem.headline: Glickman to fight to open Chile to US agriculture.

text.p: Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said Friday that Chile has "made life difficult" for the United States on some trade issues, particularly with regards to restrictions on U.S. wheat and poultry shipments.

Speaking by satellite to corn and soybean farmers attending the Commodities Classic in Tampa, Glickman said at the request of President Bill Clinton, he is going to Chile later this year to try to work out the agricultural disputes and to build stronger trade relations there.
Glickman said he plans to stay very active "in all aspects of world trade," and that it is important that agriculture stays involved in all trade negotiations.
